# 74165 - 8-bit shift register

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74165.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74165.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 33 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74165 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74165.png) | ![74165 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74165.png) | ![74165 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74165.png) |

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 1 | SHIFT/LOAD | input | low |  | acts at once (not clocked); low loads A..H into the register directly, independent of clock, clock inhibit and serial input; high allows shifting |
| 2 | CLOCK | clock |  |  | rising edge; NORed with CLOCK INHIBIT; either may be used as the clock |
| 15 | CLOCK INHIBIT | input | high |  | high inhibits clocking; change it to high only while CLOCK is high |
| 10 | SERIAL INPUT | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | A | input |  |  | parallel data input |
| 12 | B | input |  |  | parallel data input |
| 13 | C | input |  |  | parallel data input |
| 14 | D | input |  |  | parallel data input |
| 3 | E | input |  |  | parallel data input |
| 4 | F | input |  |  | parallel data input |

| 7 | /QH | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | QH = register bit H (last stage) | Output of the eighth stage. |
| 7 | /QH = NOT QH | Complement of the eighth stage. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: rising edge of (CLOCK OR CLOCK INHIBIT) while SHIFT/LOAD is high

- SHIFT/LOAD low: QA..QH = A..H at once (direct overriding load)
- SHIFT/LOAD high, CLOCK INHIBIT low, CLOCK low: hold
- SHIFT/LOAD high, CLOCK INHIBIT low, rising CLOCK edge: QA = SERIAL INPUT, QB..QH = QA..QG before the edge (shift toward QH)
- SHIFT/LOAD high, CLOCK INHIBIT high: hold
- The clock is a 2-input NOR of CLOCK and CLOCK INHIBIT; holding either high inhibits clocking, holding either low lets the other be the clock

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SHIFT/LOAD is a double load: IIL -3.2 mA, IIH 80 uA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SHIFT/LOAD | any output | PLH | 21 | 31 |
| SHIFT/LOAD | any output | PHL | 27 | 40 |
| CLOCK | any output | PLH | 16 | 24 |
| CLOCK | any output | PHL | 21 | 31 |
| H | QH | PLH | 11 | 17 |
| H | QH | PHL | 24 | 36 |
| H | /QH | PLH | 18 | 27 |
| H | /QH | PHL | 18 | 27 |
